items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: you had Kenny Rickman on trumpet; he didn't work for you that long, did he? ... No, he didn't stay with me too long

ctx.x: I did get Willard Brown back. Bob Carroll was back with me.
Where's Rickman, Rickman was with you around the time that you were recording for this Penguin label.
